images.title: Tsunami Scramble
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-definition landscape home-menu background for Deadly Jenga, a playful multiplayer physics VR game. Produce one full-bleed wide cinematic 16:9 image at the highest native resolution available. Style: a beautifully polished Unity game render, simple physically assembled block structures, glossy candy/plastic materials, stylized water and cinematic but clear lighting. All players share the canonical avatar from input image 1: featureless smooth round head, shaped torso, segmented slender arms and legs, real five-finger cartoon hands and rounded feet, saturated single-color plastic body. Preserve that recognizable silhouette; no realistic humans, faces, dolls, minifigures or unrelated character designs. Dynamic physical body language carries emotion. Structures are open stacked slab-and-pillar frameworks and walkable beams, not conventional closed skyscrapers; breakage reveals actual falling individual structural pieces. Composition: gameplay eye-level or near-player camera, action concentrated in the center/right two-thirds, a quieter lower-contrast atmospheric left quarter suitable for future menu buttons. It must still be a complete attractive scene, not a blank panel. No text, title, logos, UI, HUD, captions or watermarks anywhere. This is original promotional concept artwork suggesting in-game action, not a claim of a real captured frame.
Scene: Input image 2 is an architecture/color reference only, not a request to use the cloud setting. Create a thrilling turquoise-ocean island disaster scene. A towering curling cyan tsunami is about to slam into a huge red, green and purple block framework. On the center-right a blue player with rabbit ears clings to the near side of a tilting pillar, a yellow player reaches down from an upper ledge to help a pink player jumping across a newly broken bridge. Farther right a tower is tipping in a physically legible domino chain, slabs sliding and splashing into the sea. Wet candy surfaces, crisp suspended droplets, brilliant sun through translucent water, foam and a few large falling structural sections. Show grand scale and a coherent scramble to survive, not random debris filling every pixel. Quiet left quarter is deep blue spray and ocean haze with a clear tonal space for buttons.
